bullets.title: Vanishing Asia
bullets.creator: Kevin Kelly
bullets.note: ([@kevin2kelly](https://twitter.com/kevin2kelly/)), arguably [the real-life most interesting man in the world](https://tim.blog/2014/08/29/kevin-kelly/?utm_source=convertkit&utm_medium=convertkit&utm_campaign=5bf). Here’s a short summary from Kevin: “I relied on my [1,000 true fans](https://kk.org/thetechnium/1000-true-fans/) to fund a huge, oversized, 1,000-page celebration of old Asia. This 3-volume book set is titled [_Vanishing Asia_](https://kk.org/books/vanishing-asia), and it records 9,000 photographs of the festivals, costumes, architecture, and rituals that are disappearing in Asia.” This has been his passion project for _40 years_. Kevin did _all_ of the following: (a) took all the photos, (b) designed every page, (c) wrote a caption for each of the 9,000 photos, and (d) designed the covers and packaging. Watch [this visual feast of a video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WeeCTjka_BE) to learn more about the project.

bullets.title: Arcane: Bridging the Rift
bullets.note: This is the behind-the-scenes story of the making of [_Arcane_](https://www.netflix.com/title/81435684), my favorite animated (does that term even do it justice?) series in many years. It includes the mania, mess, and marvel of trying to do something nearly impossible. Here are Parts 1 (“[Only Dream in Risky](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mz4-38d3-AE)”) and 2 (“[Persistence (Or When Your Best Still Sucks)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xpPyPguzafU)”), with more to come.
